name: Camping 101: Blacksmithing
summary: A Blacksmith can learn to craft a Sharpening Wheel for use at camp. Basil Frye in Undercity can teach you once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

sections.title: A Smith's Camp
sections.body: Someone asks you to speak with Basil Frye in Undercity about a camping item for your Blacksmithing. You need to show proficiency in your skill before he teaches you to craft a Sharpening Wheel. At camp, the wheel lets Warriors and Rogues nearby hone their weapons.

faq.q: What can Basil Frye teach me?
faq.answer: Basil Frye can teach you to craft a Sharpening Wheel for use at camp, once you have shown proficiency in Blacksmithing.

faq.q: What does a Sharpening Wheel do?
faq.answer: A Sharpening Wheel at your camp lets nearby Warriors and Rogues hone their weapons.

faq.q: Where do I find Basil Frye?
